mapper.sql: t.id AS taskId, t.task_name AS taskName, t.template_id AS templateId, -- 状态对外统一为展示语义词（底层存「已结束」，成员卡片/筛选按「已完成」使用） CASE t.status WHEN '已结束' THEN '已完成' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.current_node_id AS currentNodeId, t.current_handler_id AS currentHandlerId, t.finished_node_count AS finishedNodeCount, t.total_node_count AS totalNodeCount, t.create_time AS createTime, s.handler_user_id AS ownerUserId, u.user_name AS ownerName, u.yyyt_id AS ownerEmpNo, u.dept_name AS ownerDept, -- 当前处理人 = 当前节点的全部待办处理人（任一完成即可）；无待办时回退为当前指针处理人（均带用户号） CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_task_node tn3 WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(u3.user_name, ' ', u3.yyyt_id) SEPARATOR '、') FROM flow_task_node tn3 LEFT JOIN aut_user u3 ON u3.yyyt_id = tn3.handler_user_id WHERE tn3.task_id = t.id AND tn3.node_id = t.current_node_id AND tn3.submit_status = 0) ELSE CONCAT(cu.user_name, ' ', cu.yyyt_id) END AS currentHandlerName, COALESCE(cn.node_name, cn2.node_name) AS currentNodeName

FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_task_node s ON s.node_type = 1 AND s.id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM flow_task_node WHERE task_id = t.id AND node_type = 1) LEFT JOIN aut_user u ON u.yyyt_id = s.handler_user_id LEFT JOIN aut_user cu ON cu.yyyt_id = t.current_handler_id -- current_node_id 指向期次快照节点（flow_task_dispatch_node），无快照的老数据回退模板节点 LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch_node cn ON cn.id = t.current_node_id LEFT JOIN flow_template_node cn2 ON cn2.id = t.current_node_id WHERE COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = #{dispatchId}

sql.if: AND (t.status = #{status} OR (#{status} = '已完成' AND t.status = '已结束'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_task_node s ON s.node_type = 1 AND s.id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM flow_task_node WHERE task_id = t.id AND node_type = 1) LEFT JOIN aut_user u ON u.yyyt_id = s.handler_user_id WHERE COALESCE(t.dispatch_id, t.id) = #{dispatchId}
